command.mac:
cd ~
gh auth switch -u shivinate7
gh workflow run browser.yml --repo shivinate7/q_max --ref claude/browser-geom-diag
command.powershell:
cd $HOME
gh auth switch -u shivinate7
gh workflow run browser.yml --repo shivinate7/q_max --ref claude/browser-geom-diag

context:
Goal: q_max main's browser suite goes green.
Why you: q_max CLAUDE.md (Commands) says CI runs the browser suite only when you start browser.yml.
Steps: open the link, press Run workflow, pick branch claude/browser-geom-diag, press Run workflow. Or paste the command below. The branch is main plus a logging patch and is never merged. Only group 2 and group 6 matter; you may cancel the other five groups to save minutes. Then press Done here. Lane qmax-browser-main-red reads the log and picks the fix.
home: lane qmax-browser-main-red reads the run log
title: Start q_max's browser workflow once on branch claude/browser-geom-diag
why: Two q_max browser checks, HISTORY-ROW-HEAD and R4-ROWACT, are 1px off on CI only. This run logs why. q_max's rules let only you start browser.yml.
